# 3 bed property for sale

> TOM MAHER & COMPANY SCSI RICS IPAV - This is a charming 2/ 3 bed semi detached double fronted EXTENDED, SOUTH-EAST FACING family home built circa 1938 complete with c. 53ft rear garden . The property offers tremendous potential to EXTEND TO THE SIDE or REAR subject to the customary planning consents. The property is eligible for the VACANT HOMES REFURBISHMENT GRANT.
